## 리얼아머
### 0.1.5 Change Log
#### Global
##### Added
* Added armor stat source selection with server confirmation.
* Added configurable armor material drops with per-item probabilities and quantity ranges.
* Added an independent Armor Drop Editor matching DRM layouts, with previews and presets.
##### Fixed
* Fixed configuration switches flashing and losing focus after clicks or server acknowledgements.
* Fixed negative and percentage armor modifiers across equipped items.
* Fixed durability loss on Elytra and armor resistant to fire.
* Fixed duplicate toolbar hover text and widely spaced flyout buttons.
##### Changed
* Removed unverified version limits for optional NPC integrations.
* Changed armor sets to save separately and activate through a single Apply selection.
* Changed standalone settings to use embedded DRM-style categories and controls.
* Changed armor drop controls by removing the global enable switch, Close, and hit playback.
##### Improved
* Improved drop list readability with separate item, chance, and quantity columns.
* Improved setting availability when connected to older servers.
#### Forge 1.20.1 / Fabric & NeoForge 1.21.1
##### Added
* Added configuration controls for the CustomNPCs resistance order.
#### Fabric 1.21.1 / Fabric 26.3
##### Fixed
* Fixed failed configuration saves reporting success instead of restoring previous values.
#### Forge 1.20.1 / NeoForge 1.21.1 & 26.3
##### Added
* Added Curios slot defense calculations for DNPC only, including body-part armor.
